lines.zh: 我的晶体腿走起来咯咯响。
lines.en: My crystal legs click as I walk.
Originium creeps inside me.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，像黏在地上。
lines.en: Each step sticks, then tears free.

lines.zh: 我拖着半截身体往前挪。
lines.en: I drag half a body forward.
Crystals push from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条断腿往前走。
lines.en: I drag a broken leg forward.

lines.zh: 走一段，就有碎片掉下来。
lines.en: Every few steps, shards fall off.
My shadow is black-violet.
Ash marks where I pass.
No hurry. Neither am I nor the stone.
I circle the abandoned camp.
My body grows heavier.
Standing, my crystals hum.
The stone crystallizes within me.

lines.zh: 尘世遗骸的第二阶段，还站得住。
lines.en: Second stage of the world's remains, still standing.

lines.zh: 这具身体已经不是人了。
lines.en: This body is no longer human.
I listen to distant ruptures.
The crystals grew an inch.
Wind through me makes a whistle.
I stand like an outcrop.

lines.zh: 我记得自己曾经的形状。
lines.en: I recall my former shape.

lines.zh: 源石矿在附近，我能感觉。
lines.en: I sense originium ore nearby.
Another living one walks in.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see the mist of your breath.
The stone gave me this shell.
You are still clean, so you can still run.

lines.zh: 尘埃堆里，我还剩第二阶段。
lines.en: Dust and remains. Phase two.
Do not touch my crystals.
This is a contaminated zone.
You keep your distance. Good.
I once watched others like this.
Leave while I am unwilling to move.

lines.zh: 我身上的晶体掉了，还会再长。
lines.en: The crystal I shed will grow again.
Violet grit scatters.

lines.zh: 我的晶体腿转过来，咯咯作响。
lines.en: My crystal legs turn with a grinding sound.

lines.zh: 这一击把晶体打进去半寸。
lines.en: That drove a crystal half an inch in.
Another crack in this body.
Originium grows out of the wound.

lines.zh: 你打得动我，但你打不完。
lines.en: You can hit me. You cannot finish me.
That knocked me off balance.
I lean and wait for it to grow straight.
The stone is mending me.
Iron? I am all stone inside.
Showing me raw originium?

lines.zh: 那东西会让我长得更快。
lines.en: That would make me grow faster.
Food does nothing for this body.
Put the ore down and step back.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只想要更多源石。
lines.en: I am not hungry. I want more stone.

lines.zh: 那块矿，抵得上我一条腿。
lines.en: That ore is worth one of my legs.
Do not hand it over. It cuts.
Good quality. Leave it.
Your arm will tire.

lines.zh: 撞上我的晶体，你的手破了。
lines.en: You hit my crystals. Your hand bleeds.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，碎片掉下来。
lines.en: I step back; shards fall.
Not too close. It cuts.
Heavier than I look.
Your push tilts me.

lines.zh: 碰撞让晶体又裂了一处。
lines.en: The bump cracks another crystal.
I straighten and walk on.
You step back; my grit remains.
Touch me and it leaves a violet mark.

lines.zh: 我的肩骨顶住了你的胸口。
lines.en: My shoulder bone meets your chest.

lines.zh: 这副身体，做不了那种事。
lines.en: This body cannot do that.
Originium does not breed. It spreads.

lines.zh: 我连自己的名字都想不起来了。
lines.en: I cannot recall my own name.

lines.zh: 别问了，这是感染者的痛。
lines.en: Do not ask. It is an Infected's pain.

lines.zh: 我们只是些走动的遗骸。
lines.en: We are walking remains.

lines.zh: 我记不清以前有没有家。
lines.en: I cannot remember a home.
The stone will keep growing in my place.

lines.zh: 你该走了，这话题让我慢。
lines.en: Go. That topic slows me.
Silence is better. Ask less.

lines.zh: 我不再是能被问这些的东西。
lines.en: I am no longer something to ask.

lines.zh: 那块源石碎片，我吸收了。
lines.en: I absorb that originium shard.
I leave what you dropped.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很慢，晶体会卡住。
lines.en: Bending is slow. My crystals catch.
Ore slag on the ground is useful.
I press it into my arm.
I cannot hold this iron.
Afterward, I am a little heavier.

lines.zh: 我把它按进胸口的裂隙。
lines.en: I press it into the crack in my chest.
Your things smell of blood.
Do not let me pick it up. It would catch.
Your steps shake the ore seam.
The stone inside me tightens.
I raise an arm. Heavy.
This is my vein of ore.
I have locked your breathing.
I do not shout. The crystals do.
You stepped into the zone.

lines.zh: 这一下，是为了那些遗骸。
lines.en: This is for the remains.
The remains shuffle toward you, one step at a time.
You have backed to the mine mouth.
The stone urges me on.
Now the crystals begin to grow.
Head turned to you; the originium is hot.
The stone burns in my chest.
Your wound has a smell.

lines.zh: 我的第二形态，只剩骨头。
lines.en: My second form is only bones.

lines.zh: 我走一步，地上多一道痕。
lines.en: A step, another mark on the ground.

lines.zh: 晶体从我小腿一节节顶出来。
lines.en: Crystals push out of my shin, joint by joint.

lines.zh: 你听见晶体互相摩擦吗？
lines.en: Hear the crystals grinding?
Your breath stirs the stone.
I count the steps you gave.
You have no stone, so you tire.
My body grows outward.
Violet spots spread on the ground.

lines.zh: 你的脚印边缘开始发紫。
lines.en: Violet creeps around the edges of your footprints.

lines.zh: 矿洞里回响着你的脚步。
lines.en: Your steps echo in the mine.
I need no sleep. You do.
All of this will be stone.

lines.zh: 我的腿在泥里拔出又插进。
lines.en: My leg pulls free and sinks again.

lines.zh: 紫色的尘顺着风往你飘。
lines.en: Violet dust drifts your way.
Spikes start under your feet.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，身子就长一寸。
lines.en: Each step, I grow an inch.
The vein extends behind me.
You stop to breathe. I keep walking.

lines.zh: 晶体在你脚边竖了起来。
lines.en: Crystals stand up around your feet.
I find you without looking.

lines.zh: 晶体手臂砸在你的盾上。
lines.en: My crystal arm crashes on your shield.

lines.zh: 这一撞带着源石的碎屑。
lines.en: That blow carries originium grit.
A shallow cut opens on you.
I feel no pain and do not stop.
Crystals burst up at your feet.
Clumsy, but heavy.

lines.zh: 我的身体碎了一角，没关系。
lines.en: A corner of me breaks. No matter.
You retreat over a floor of shards.
These remains still bite.

lines.zh: 源石让我比活着时更硬。
lines.en: The stone made me harder than life.
My crystal fist drives into the ground.
Shards slice your leggings.

lines.zh: 我抓住你，手上的石很凉。
lines.en: I seize you. The stone is cold.

lines.zh: 这一击让地面裂成网状。
lines.en: That splits the ground into a web.
The blow drops you to one knee.

lines.zh: 我的手臂断了一截，还能打。
lines.en: My arm snaps off. Still fighting.
The stone pushes out of my wound.

lines.zh: 这一下，把你也算进矿脉。
lines.en: That counts you into the vein.

lines.zh: 你退开，地上有我的一片。
lines.en: You retreat; a piece of me remains.

lines.zh: 我不喘气，所以还能再来。
lines.en: I do not gasp, so I come again.

lines.zh: 矿洞里传出晶体生长声。
lines.en: Crystals grow in the dark mine.

lines.zh: 遗骸从矿石堆里站起来。
lines.en: The remains rise from the ore pile.

lines.zh: 紫色的光从裂缝透出来。
lines.en: Violet light leaks from a crack.

lines.zh: 这一带的地面开始结晶。
lines.en: The ground here begins to crystallize.
The originium vein has run wild.
I lift my head from the wasteland.

lines.zh: 有个东西在矿口站起来了。
lines.en: Something stands at the mine mouth.

lines.zh: 你听见石头互相挤压吗？
lines.en: Hear the stone pressing together?
This body has pulled together again.
I drag a leg out of the dark.
The stone's dream is awake.
This ground belongs to the ore.
Fire makes my crystals brittle.

lines.zh: 我从矿口滚下去，碎了几块。
lines.en: I roll down the mine slope and break.
Water in the cracks makes me heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我炸散了一半，剩下一半还站。
lines.en: The blast scattered half of me; the rest stands.
An arrow wedges among the crystals.

lines.zh: 法术压住了源石，只是暂时。
lines.en: Spellcraft quiets the originium. Only for now.

lines.zh: 没有源石补充，我慢下来。
lines.en: Without ore, I slow.

lines.zh: 雷把我的晶体烧成了白。
lines.en: Lightning burned my crystals white.
No ore below. Only void.
